_description: Standard answers for ATS application questions. Reusable across all job applications.
_customization_note: Entries with answer 'ASK_USER' must never be auto-filled: stop and show the exact question to the user. U.S.-citizen applicants: set authorization in config/profile.json.

previously_employed.notes: Default No unless applying to a company we've worked at before

sponsorship_required.notes: Set per applicant in config/profile.json. Always answer truthfully.

authorized_to_work.notes: Set to your actual authorization status

non_compete.notes: Applicant should confirm once that no non-compete / non-solicit from a prior employer applies.

background_check_consent.notes: Consent to background / credit checks: confirm with the user once per employer; finance firms usually run them.

willing_to_relocate.notes: Applicant is open to U.S. locations (finance hubs preferred). Confirm per posting if a specific city is required.

how_did_you_hear.notes: Use the real source for each application (LinkedIn, company site, referral, school career portal). Ask if unsure.

start_date.notes: Full-time roles: after May 2027. For internships, state availability honestly (check the posting's dates) and ask the user if the posting's dates do not fit.

criminal_history.notes: Never auto-answer. Show the exact question to the user.

expected_salary.answer_strategy: Leave blank if optional. If required, enter 'Negotiable' or ask the user. Do not invent a number.

legal_or_regulatory.notes: Never auto-answer. Finance employers ask about regulatory history; show the exact question to the user.

veteran_status.notes: Set in config/profile.json or choose 'I do not wish to answer'. Not auto-answered by default.

alt_answers: I do not wish to answer
disability_status.notes: Default is decline. Health-related; the user can set a different answer in config/profile.json.

gender.notes: Optional. Default is decline; the user can set an answer in config/profile.json.

alt_answers: I do not wish to answer
race_ethnicity.notes: Optional. Default is decline; the user can set an answer in config/profile.json.

notes: Workday uses data-automation-id for all elements
Dropdowns are NOT native <select> - they're div-based custom components
Click the button with aria-haspopup, then click the promptOption
Field IDs are dynamic hex GUIDs unique to each company's Workday tenant
Match questions by text content, not by field ID

_policy: Voluntary self-identification (EEO) questions default to decline unless the user sets a different answer.
